name: CoolIT CHx2000 row-based CDU
description: Row-based liquid-to-liquid CDU in a 750 x 1200 mm footprint; CoolIT rates it for 12 x GB300 NVL72 racks. Hot-swappable pumps and TCS filters, 25 micron filtration, stainless piping, 4 in tri-clamp FWS/TCS, group control of 20 units.

capacity_w.note: 2000 kW at 5 C ATD (facility supply to TCS supply); supply temperatures not published. CoolIT's own comparison table estimates 2269 kW at 4 C ATD with PG25 (press report, StorageReview)

max_flow_kg_s.note: 2125 L/min at 35 psi from product page; 2125 * 0.998 / 60 = 35.35 kg/s. The 2026 sell sheet's '2 MW at 1.5 LPM/kW' implies ~3000 L/min, presumably at lower head; not used

pump_head_kpa.note: 35 psi * 6.895 = 241.3 kPa available at 2125 L/min. Press (StorageReview) cites 53 psi secondary head pressure, likely at lower flow

power_w.note: power consumption as listed on the product page

weight_kg.note: not published on CoolIT product page or sell sheet as of 2026-10

attrs.pump_redundancy: redundant hot-swappable pumps (count not published on current page)

sources.title: StorageReview: CoolIT unveils CHx2000 CDU with 2MW liquid cooling capacity
